title: T2.2: output.rs — StoryView.progress, type + progress rendering

text:
Requirements: R25, R26, R27, R31. Files: src/output.rs.
AC: StoryView.progress: Option<ProgressRollup> with skip_serializing_if; render_story shows type after priority with default fallback; progress line when present; list shows [type] badge and progress summary; JSON includes story_type and progress via serde.
